cards.text: This is Nehemiah son of Hacaliah, and he's telling this story himself, so you're getting it straight from the man. It's the month of Chislev, in the twentieth year. He's in the citadel of Susa, a royal city of Persia.
Then Hanani, one of Nehemiah's brothers, arrives with men from Judah. I bet they didn't get one sandal off before Nehemiah was on them like me at the oven door when the timer dings.

cards.question: Nehemiah's got questions for the men from Judah. What does he ask them about?

answers.text: The Jews who survived the exile and Jerusalem
The temple priests and their offerings
The king's army and the roads to Judah

cards.text: The men tell him the survivors of the exile are there in the province, in great trouble and disgrace. Friend, he asks how everybody's doing in Judah, and they don't even warm up with a "well, the weather's been nice" first!

cards.question: Then the men report on Jerusalem itself. What shape are the city's wall and gates in?

answers.text: The wall's broken down and the gates are burned
The wall's half built and the gates are locked
The wall's cracked but the gates still stand

cards.question: Nehemiah hears the news about Jerusalem's wall and gates, and he sits down and weeps.

cards.text: And it's not a quick cry and back to work. Nehemiah mourns for DAYS, and friend, when a batch sticks to my pan, I give it ten seconds of silence and grab the spatula.

cards.question: While Nehemiah mourns, he's fasting and ___ before the God of heaven.

cards.text: Then Nehemiah prays, and he doesn't open like that one friend whose texts ALL start with "Hey, quick favor." He starts with who God is: the LORD, God of heaven, the great and awesome God.

cards.question: Nehemiah says God keeps His covenant of loving devotion with every nation on earth.

cards.text: Next he asks God to let His eyes be open and His ears attentive to his prayer. He says he's praying day and night for the Israelites, and friend, I can't stay awake through ONE batch in the oven.

cards.question: In his prayer, Nehemiah says both he and his father's house have sinned.
Nehemiah says Israel has kept the commandments, statutes and ordinances God gave His servant Moses, Israel's leader.

cards.text: Then Nehemiah asks God to remember His word to Moses: if the people are unfaithful, God will scatter them among the nations. Nehemiah's praying God's own words right back to Him.

cards.question: God's word to Moses also talks about exiles who return to Him and keep His commandments. What will God do for them?

answers.text: Gather them and bring them to His chosen place
Bless them right where they've been scattered
Raise up a new king to lead them

cards.text: Then Nehemiah tells God whose people these are: His servants and His people, the ones He redeemed by His great power and mighty hand. I know a little about being rescued from the back of a junk drawer, friend, and I can tell you it BEATS staying there.
Nehemiah asks God to listen to his prayer and the prayers of His servants who delight to revere His name. Then he asks God for success this day, and it has something to do with one particular man.

cards.question: At the end of his prayer, Nehemiah asks God to grant him ___ in the sight of one particular man.
Right at the end, Nehemiah drops one more detail about his job at that time. What was it?

cards.text: That's where Nehemiah's prayer leaves us for now, friend. Trust me, this story is just getting STARTED.
